# COSMoS API Reference

REST API documentation for COSMoS

## API Reference

### CDISC Conceptual and Operational Standards Metadata (COSMoS)

Path: `/COSMoS/reference/`
Version: 2.0

REST API documentation for COSMoS

#### Operations

##### GET /mdr/bc/packages

Get Biomedical Concept Package List

Responses:
- 200: OK
- 400: Bad Request
- 401: Unauthorized
- 403: Forbidden
- 404: Not Found
- 405: Method Not Allowed
- 406: Not Acceptable
- 500: Internal Server Error
- 503: Service Unavailable
- 504: Gateway Timeout Error

##### GET /mdr/bc/packages/{package}/biomedicalconcepts

Get Biomedical Concept List

Parameters:
- `package` (path, string, required) - Biomedical Concept Package Identifier

Responses:
- 200: OK
- 400: Bad Request
- 401: Unauthorized
- 403: Forbidden
- 404: Not Found
- 405: Method Not Allowed
- 406: Not Acceptable
- 500: Internal Server Error
- 503: Service Unavailable
- 504: Gateway Timeout Error

##### GET /mdr/bc/packages/{package}/biomedicalconcepts/{biomedicalconcept}

Get Biomedical Concept

Parameters:
- `package` (path, string, required) - Biomedical Concept Package Identifier
- `biomedicalconcept` (path, string, required) - Biomedical Concept Identifier

Responses:
- 200: OK
- 400: Bad Request
- 401: Unauthorized
- 403: Forbidden
- 404: Not Found
- 405: Method Not Allowed
- 406: Not Acceptable
- 500: Internal Server Error
- 503: Service Unavailable
- 504: Gateway Timeout Error

##### GET /mdr/bc/categories

Get Biomedical Concept Categories List

Responses:
- 200: OK
- 400: Bad Request
- 401: Unauthorized
- 403: Forbidden
- 404: Not Found
- 405: Method Not Allowed
- 406: Not Acceptable
- 500: Internal Server Error
- 503: Service Unavailable
- 504: Gateway Timeout Error

##### GET /mdr/bc/biomedicalconcepts

Get Biomedical Concept List across Packages, optionally limited to a category

Parameters:
- `category` (query, string, optional) - Biomedical Concept Category

Responses:
- 200: OK
- 400: Bad Request
- 401: Unauthorized
- 403: Forbidden
- 404: Not Found
- 405: Method Not Allowed
- 406: Not Acceptable
- 500: Internal Server Error
- 503: Service Unavailable
- 504: Gateway Timeout Error

##### GET /mdr/bc/biomedicalconcepts/{biomedicalconcept}

Get Biomedical Concept (Latest)

Parameters:
- `biomedicalconcept` (path, string, required) - Biomedical Concept Identifier

Responses:
- 200: OK
- 400: Bad Request
- 401: Unauthorized
- 403: Forbidden
- 404: Not Found
- 405: Method Not Allowed
- 406: Not Acceptable
- 500: Internal Server Error
- 503: Service Unavailable
- 504: Gateway Timeout Error

##### GET /mdr/specializations/sdtm/packages

Get SDTM Dataset Specialization Package List

Responses:
- 200: OK
- 400: Bad Request
- 401: Unauthorized
- 403: Forbidden
- 404: Not Found
- 405: Method Not Allowed
- 406: Not Acceptable
- 500: Internal Server Error
- 503: Service Unavailable
- 504: Gateway Timeout Error

##### GET /mdr/specializations/sdtm/packages/{package}/datasetspecializations

Get SDTM Dataset Specialization List

Parameters:
- `package` (path, string, required) - SDTM Dataset Specialization Package Identifier

Responses:
- 200: OK
- 400: Bad Request
- 401: Unauthorized
- 403: Forbidden
- 404: Not Found
- 405: Method Not Allowed
- 406: Not Acceptable
- 500: Internal Server Error
- 503: Service Unavailable
- 504: Gateway Timeout Error

##### GET /mdr/specializations/sdtm/packages/{package}/datasetspecializations/{datasetspecialization}

Get SDTM Dataset Specialization

Parameters:
- `package` (path, string, required) - SDTM Dataset Specialization Package Identifier
- `datasetspecialization` (path, string, required) - SDTM Dataset Specialization Identifier

Responses:

- 404: Not Found
- 405: Method Not Allowed
- 406: Not Acceptable
- 500: Internal Server Error
- 503: Service Unavailable
- 504: Gateway Timeout Error

Responses:

- 403: Forbidden

- 500: Internal Server Error
- 503: Service Unavailable
- 504: Gateway Timeout Error

##### GET /mdr/specializations/sdtm/datasetspecializations

Get SDTM Dataset Specialization List across Packages, optionally limited to a domain

Parameters:
- `domain` (query, string, optional) - SDTM Dataset Specialization Domain

Responses:
- 200: OK
- 400: Bad Request
- 401: Unauthorized
- 403: Forbidden
- 404: Not Found
- 405: Method Not Allowed
- 406: Not Acceptable
- 500: Internal Server Error
- 503: Service Unavailable
- 504: Gateway Timeout Error

##### GET /mdr/specializations/sdtm/datasetspecializations/{datasetspecialization}

Get SDTM Dataset Specialization (Latest)

Parameters:
- `datasetspecialization` (path, string, required) - SDTM Dataset Specialization Identifier

Responses:
- 200: OK
- 400: Bad Request
- 401: Unauthorized
- 403: Forbidden
- 404: Not Found
- 405: Method Not Allowed
- 406: Not Acceptable
- 500: Internal Server Error
- 503: Service Unavailable
- 504: Gateway Timeout Error

##### GET /mdr/specializations/datasetspecializations

Get Dataset Specializations that specialize a Biomedical Concept

Parameters:
- `biomedicalconcept` (query, string, optional) - Biomedical Concept Identifier

Responses:
- 200: OK
- 400: Bad Request
- 401: Unauthorized
- 403: Forbidden
- 404: Not Found
- 405: Method Not Allowed
- 406: Not Acceptable
- 500: Internal Server Error
- 503: Service Unavailable
- 504: Gateway Timeout Error
